answer: Fixed-pool dilution bond: each identity locks 70 credits in a sable ledger, one entry per key, with a fixed 40,000 credit pool, so fakes dilute shares. Each finishes one 45-credit canyon job per epoch, key-signed. An ember checkpoint samples 10% and demands an ember-sealed proof in an hour; borrowed proof burns the bond. One fake costs 115, so 1,000 fakes pay 115,000 for 40,000 split 1,000 ways; an honest agent pays 115 once and keeps its share.
